title: Financial Counseling Q&A: Approved Hardship Applications and Payment Plan Length
content:
**Rule.** On the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program, an approved hardship application of the program received within the last 12 calendar months adds 2 installments to a payment plan, an older approved one adds 1, and otherwise nothing is added. A date falls within the last 12 calendar months when it is later than the same calendar day 12 months earlier.

**Q. Which applications count?** Hardship applications on the program whose request status is approved; their received date decides whether they are recent.

**Q. If a recent and an older approved application are both on file?** The recent one decides: 2 installments are added.

**Q. Where is the 12-month line? (hypothetical: today is 4 November)** An approved application received on 5 November of the previous year is recent and adds 2; one received on 4 November of the previous year is older and adds 1.

**Q. And with no approved application?** Nothing is added.
